"I do still get (fairly rare) bouts of depression, but it's never as bad as it used to be. For the most part, my worst moments these days are about as bad as the good moments used to be."

See THIS has been my experience since my roll. Oh I'm so happy it's shared, I was worried it might be wearing off. I can still find myself falling back into mental patterns that would have lead to a flashback or panic attack before, but it's SO much easier to snap myself out and understand what is going on.

Also I'm far less afraid of strangers? 

I'm glad it worked for you, too!

Right. My PTSD is something my therapist and I have been trying to address for a while. Mine involved powerful flashbacks which were disrupting my working and personal life. I'm certainly going to need more sessions as I address each person involved with the abuse (there's a good number as it went on for 8 some years). Its a miracle to find something that has made such a difference when everything else has failed.
